name: Shopping shortlist
description: On a product page, right-click and choose Save to shopping shortlist. Enter the displayed price and currency, optionally a product name and variant or comparison notes. A blank name uses the page title; selected text is used as details when none are entered. Saves a local note with the source URL and date. Prices are entered by you, not guessed; no automatic price tracking, AI or external requests.

actions.name: Save to shopping shortlist
